source_review.meaning: Static ownership/contract review coverage; this is not a claim of complete path coverage or absence of all defects.

published_runtime_fixes.description: Refresh canonical routing and protected-core eligibility after external has() callbacks.
Prepare resolver slots and attribute plan at one revision before executing a parameter.
Drain newly registered deferred dependency IDs before external publication; inspect each ID once.
Recognize classes loaded by interface fallback in ClassDefinition and AttributeDefinition target/selectors.
Reject mapped DTO source conflicts before factory invocation when fallback probes load a DTO/source class.
Record the bridge plan actually consumed instead of later metadata which can describe unexecuted handlers.
Share prepared plans across case variants of an already resolved native callable class name.

independent_final_runtime_diff_review.result: PASS; no material findings in the assembled correction diff and its adjacent publication/invalidation boundaries.
independent_final_runtime_diff_review.method: Independent bounded source and public regression review, separate from the implementation and full-suite runs.

specification_review.semantic_review: All three plans and their complete Russian translations received independent semantic review; final runtime corrections were cross-checked against the callback and availability contracts.

published_tooling_fix.description: Select and verify benchmark classes and autoload functions before optimized Composer loading.

entry_review.scope_exclusion: SetUpRunner and SetUp unwrappers are assigned to another reviewer. Supporting metadata paths read for boundary analysis.
false_positives_or_preserved_contracts: Replaced/rejected callable closures and captures are collectible before Reflection::clearReflectors on both runtimes; actual registration does not reproduce the proposed reflection WeakMap retention.
AliasResolver does not memoize unmapped identity IDs: source returns before its path cache.
An already running factory may return its old result; current revisions prevent stale publication, including Fiber scenarios.
ReferenceDefinition is an argument descriptor, not an unsupported top-level binding defect.
ClassDefinition deliberately skips DI attributes and ignores unused runtime overrides while rejecting unused explicit configured arguments.
Abandoned suspended Fiber ownership recovery remains green in existing public contract tests.
entry_review.architecture: Next-major selected target centralizes authoritative DefinitionBinding snapshots in CompositeResolver; strategies have no per-ID registrations; internal mutation retirement remains necessary across definitions and caches. No major implementation made.
